claim: SCROLC is the signed pending-scroll count: positive = pending up-scrolls, negative = pending down-scrolls.
DEAD is the number of remaining millipede segments; zero means the train is gone.
CENTIN is the length of the centipede (train).
SCROLL is the dispatcher that scrolls the playfield up or down.
No scrolling in attract mode (MODE bit 7).
No scrolling while the CONWAY metamorphosis is running (CDONE non-zero).
No scrolling while a DDT bomb is exploding.
No scrolling while the player is dead/exploding.
A hit DDT skips the continuous-scroll arm (pending SCROLC still dispatches).
A dead train (DEAD==0) skips the continuous-scroll arm.
Continuous scroll only on the CENTIN==4 wave.
The continuous-scroll timer masks FRAME with $7F (128-frame period).
The continuous-scroll tick fires at frame phase $1E within the period.
The continuous tick is DEC SCROLC — it queues a DOWN-scroll.
SCROLC zero means no scroll.
Negative SCROLC dispatches to SCROLD (scroll down).
Positive SCROLC dispatches to SCROLU (scroll up).
SCROLD consumes one pending down-scroll (INC SCROLC).
The column sweep starts at PLYFLD+$3A0 — column 29, right to left.
Upright down-shift starts writing at top row $1E.
Down-scroll bottom-region boundary row is $0B (MUSH count region).
Down-scroll top-region boundary row is $13 (MUSH+2 count region).
A new top mushroom is added only when RND1 & $0F == 0 (1 in 16 per column).

source.verbatim: BNE 12$			;AND IN ONLY A FEW MUSHROOMS AT THE TOP

claim: Each random top mushroom increments MUSH+2 (top-region count).

source.verbatim: INC X,MUSH+2		;INCREASE COUNT OF MUSHROOMS AT TOP

claim: The added top mushroom is picture code $7F (fully-grown normal).
The upright down-shift moves each previous row down one row.
The down-shift loop stops after writing row 2 (rows 0-1 untouched).
After the shift, row 6 (player-area re-entry row) is rewritten.
The row-6 rewrite ORs in the $80 grey-background bit.
A poison mushroom scrolled into the player area becomes a normal mushroom (ORA $04).
The mushroom/rock threshold for count bookkeeping is picture code $70.
A mushroom pushed off the bottom row decrements MUSH.
A mushroom crossing down into the bottom region (row $0B) increments MUSH.

source.verbatim: INC X,MUSH		;ADD COUNT FOR NEW MUSHROOM

claim: A mushroom crossing down out of the top region (row $13) decrements MUSH+2.

source.verbatim: DEC X,MUSH+2		;WE LOST ONE FROM THE TOP

claim: The sweep steps one column ($20) at a time toward column 0.
SCROLU consumes one pending up-scroll (DEC SCROLC).
Upright up-shift starts writing at bottom row 2.
Up-scroll bottom-region boundary row is $0C.
Up-scroll top-region boundary row is $14.
The cell entering at the bottom on an up-scroll is $80 — a grey blank.
The upright up-shift moves each previous row up one row.
The up-shift loop stops after writing row $1E (row $1F untouched).
After the shift, row 7 (player-area exit row) is rewritten.
The row-7 rewrite ANDs with $7F — the grey bit is stripped on exit.
A mushroom pushed off the top row decrements MUSH+2.
A mushroom crossing up out of the bottom region (row $0B->$0C) decrements MUSH.

source.verbatim: DEC X,MUSH		;CHANGE COUNT FOR LOSS OF MUSHROOM

claim: A mushroom crossing up into the top region (row $14) increments MUSH+2.

source.verbatim: INC X,MUSH+2		;WE ADDED ONE TO THE TOP

claim: SCROLU tail-calls SCROL0, which removes an obstacle scrolled onto the player (needs OBSTAC — deferred to ml3-3).

source.verbatim: JMP SCROL0		;REMOVE OBSTACLE ON TOP OF PLAYER.

claim: Down-scroll seeds at most one DDT bomb per scroll on the top row (DDTADD table — descoped from ml3-5).
Up-scroll clears DDT-bomb table entries that move off the top (descoped from ml3-5).
